entities.summary: Ottoman, a notable figure in the history of Lebanon, associated with Mamluk and Early Ottoman Lebanon (1516–1590). Preceded by Early Ottoman Period and Ma'n Dynasty and Mamluk Period. Their legacy influenced Ottomans capture and execute Fakhreddine II in Istanbul.
